text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're in the middle of summer camp,
and Sakura
Chiyono O is running full
speed along the beach.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okay!
choice_data_list: 次はもっと脚の回転数を増やして！

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Chiyo's really pouring her all into that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky. Are you here on a break?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh—Rudolf... Yes, I'm here on vacation
to enjoy
the ocean breeze.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The view sure is wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...It certainly is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There is much talk around the Classic
Triple
Crown. Yaeno Muteki is the
favorite for the
Kikuka Sho, while Super
Creek is watching keenly
for an opening.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...The public's gaze, however, seems to
have
locked firmly on to two particular
racers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's a battle between the White
Lightning who's
overturning conventions
left and right through
sheer hard work,
and the Beast who shoulders the
dreams
of her hometown's people.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap in particular has secured a
great deal
of influence, even capturing
the hearts of
non-racing fans. Everyone
is expecting great
things from her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They're both running in the autumn
Tenno Sho
this year. I'm sure it will be a
race to remember.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...It's fresh faces like them that make the
Twinkle
Series sparkle like it does.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. We are truly experiencing a
boom in
races that will help the whole
racing world
flourish.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The younger generation has opened the
path. Of
course, our own path still lies
before us as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky. I heard you didn't respond
to your
invitation to the Dream Trophy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The URA would welcome your
participation, and
the Dream Trophy
focuses less on competition
and more on
star power... It seems like a fine
prospect
for you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
True, you wouldn't be able to return to
the
Twinkle Series, but if you're going to
withdraw
from races either way, wouldn't
it be best to put
that behind you and—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...I know, Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to give all of my
secrets—all
of my treasures—to that
bright-eyed young racer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
To pass down all the hopes and dreams I
never
managed to fulfill, all wrapped up
in a beautiful
ribbon.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to give her everything I could...
before I
lose it all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I thought that if I could just... pass the
baton to
someone who looked up to me,
I'd be able to
move on...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And yet... look at me now. And look at
her...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Huff... Trainer... I can keep going...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not good enough... Let's keep
going...
Please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O's eyes burn brighter
than the
summer sun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's not the same as she was before the
Satsuki
Sho. Her muscles are stronger,
and her body's
more resilient. I'm sure
she can handle even more
intense
training.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A sumo match? Really?!
choice_data_list: ぶつかり稽古をしよう
ビーチランニングを続けよう

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Not to brag or anything, but I'm pretty
good at
that. I might send you flying...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Then who am I wrestling?
choice_data_list: さすがに俺相手じゃないよ
さすがに私相手じゃないよ

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Dosukoooi! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Hishi Akebono, Tracen's
representative
Sumomusume, known for
her extraordinary size...
A worthy
opponent indeed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But in sumo, there are no weight classes!
Let's do
this! I'll be on the offense this
time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Buono! ♪ I like that look you've got in
your eyes!
I'll do my best to help you
train!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Slaaaam!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inside a makeshift sumo ring drawn in
the sand,
the two racers train and sweat
under the shining
sun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Of course, this isn't just for fun. It'll
make great
strength training for her
lower body. No doubt
this will lead to
more overall power in her races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'll run to my limit—
Whoooooaaa! Can I run with you?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ack! Bamboo? You sprinted over with so
much
energy! Like, almost an abnormal
amount...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of course! How could I possibly miss this
chance
to run with you?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
W-with me?! But I heard your next race
will be on
dirt again. I don't think we'll
be able to compete
head-to-head
anytime soo—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's why this is such a rare
opportunity! Summer
camp's a great
place to meet, run, and train with
strong
rivals, regardless of your planned races!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So please! Race with me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Thank youuuu! Let's goooo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hmph! I won't. Just watch me!
choice_data_list: チヨノオーは負けないようにね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not wanting to be outdone, Sakura
Chiyono O
runs along the beach with
Bamboo Memory.
